description: Post-core advisory candidates derived from the ReactorPrompt incremental visual-semantics research. They encode observable relations rather than equipment, brand, mood, identity, or functional-truth claims. T14 failure prevention and T15 clause lineage are implemented as policy/test boundaries instead of image candidates.

composition.ko: 프레임 경계가 의미 앵커를 자르지 않는 크롭 관계
composition.en: crop-boundary integrity that keeps every meaning-bearing anchor and its connection inside the frame
composition.embedding_text: the crop keeps every required landmark, contact point, connected limb, material edge, and directional continuation visible while incidental regions may leave the frame

composition.ko: 정확한 패널 수와 순서가 읽히는 다중 패널 토폴로지
composition.en: multi-panel topology with an exact panel count, stable layout, and readable sequence
composition.embedding_text: an exact number of visually separated panels preserves a stable grid or sequence, unique content per panel, readable ordering, and unambiguous outer boundaries

composition.ko: 전경·중경·배경이 독립 단서로 이어지는 깊이 사슬
composition.en: foreground-to-midground-to-background depth chain with independent overlap, scale, and atmosphere cues
composition.embedding_text: a grounded near-plane anchor connects through a readable midground bridge to a distant background using at least two independent depth cues rather than blur alone

composition.en: product body, support surface, and secondary prop hierarchy with unambiguous contact
composition.embedding_text: one primary product retains a clean complete silhouette and physically coherent contact with its support surface while secondary props remain subordinate and non-occluding

composition.ko: 음식의 재료 상태와 용기 접촉 관계
composition.en: food material state visibly coupled to its vessel, utensil, and local temperature evidence
composition.embedding_text: the food surface, vessel boundary, utensil interaction, and visible heat or moisture consequence agree in one frame without claiming taste, recipe authenticity, or safety

composition.ko: 자연 피사체와 서식 환경 상태의 관찰 가능한 연결
composition.en: observable subject-state and habitat relation without inferring hidden ecological function
composition.embedding_text: a visible animal or plant state connects to a specific habitat surface, shelter, contact, or weather trace while population health and ecological function remain unclaimed

body_pose.ko: 한 다리는 지지하고 반대 다리는 뒤로 굽혀 드는 역학
body_pose.en: single-support stance with the free leg flexed backward and load visibly owned by the planted side
body_pose.embedding_text: one planted foot and loaded hip own the body weight while the opposite knee bends backward as a non-supporting free leg and the torso visibly counterbalances

body_framing.ko: 앞으로 기운 몸통과 지지 단서를 함께 남기는 근접 프레이밍
body_framing.en: close framing that preserves a forward torso lean together with its support and depth cues
body_framing.embedding_text: the close crop retains shoulder and torso pitch, a readable support or counterbalance cue, and depth foreshortening so forward lean cannot collapse into a flat head-and-shoulders pose

contact_point.ko: 지지 하중 없이 손끝과 표적이 닿는 가벼운 접촉
contact_point.en: fingertip contact with one visible target while the contact remains non-load-bearing
contact_point.embedding_text: one anatomically connected fingertip touches a clearly visible target at a precise point while body support remains elsewhere and no weight-bearing deformation is implied

contact_point.ko: 하중을 전달하며 수신면이 국소 변형되는 접촉
contact_point.en: load-bearing contact with a visible force path and local receiver deformation
contact_point.embedding_text: a visible actor or object transfers load through one contact patch, creating direction-consistent compression or deformation on the receiver and a readable counterforce

action.ko: 도구 접촉과 진행 중 공정 및 즉시 결과가 함께 보이는 동작
action.en: active tool contact that shows the ongoing process and one immediate visible result
action.embedding_text: an actor grips one tool in coherent contact with a visible target surface during an unfinished operation, with one immediate material or state change already readable

lens.ko: 카메라 거리와 투영 효과가 장면 전반에서 일관된 관계
lens.en: source-relative camera distance and projection effects that remain coherent across the scene
lens.embedding_text: camera distance owns relative scale and foreshortening while focal-length metadata remains secondary; faces, hands, props, and architecture share one coherent projection

focus.ko: 의미 앵커가 같은 초점면에서 우선 읽히는 관계
focus.en: focus-plane priority that keeps the meaning-bearing subject anchors jointly readable
focus.embedding_text: the primary focus plane contains every meaning-bearing anchor that must be judged together while secondary depth softens gradually without hiding required contact or topology

light_shape.ko: 연결된 수신면을 따라 이어지고 변형되는 패턴 그림자
light_shape.en: one patterned cast shadow continuing and deforming across connected receiver surfaces
light_shape.embedding_text: one leaf slat or lattice occluder projects alternating bright and dark structure that bends with curvature and continues across at least two connected receiver regions

lighting.ko: 주변 일광 방향을 유지하며 플래시가 그림자 밀도만 여는 균형
lighting.en: daylight key direction preserved while near-axis fill flash opens shadow density without a second shadow
lighting.embedding_text: the non-flash daylight or ambient key remains directionally visible while near-camera fill flash reduces its shadow density, preserves background exposure, and creates no opposing cast shadow

lighting.ko: 같은 광원 아래 서로 다른 재질 응답을 구분하는 관계
lighting.en: same-source lighting that produces distinct matte, glossy, wet, metallic, or translucent responses
lighting.embedding_text: one traceable source direction acts on two or more materials whose highlight width, diffuse gradient, wet reflection, metallic compactness, or transmission edge remain visibly distinct

color_grading.ko: 주색·보조색·강조색의 면적과 위치가 만든 팔레트 위계
color_grading.en: palette hierarchy with primary, supporting, and accent colors owned by distinct regions
color_grading.embedding_text: one dominant color field, one supporting region, and one bounded accent keep distinct area and location roles so the palette directs attention rather than becoming an equal color list

color_grading.ko: 같은 표면 안의 한정된 선택색 예외와 연속성
color_grading.en: bounded selective-color exception on one continuous surface while tonal structure stays coherent
color_grading.embedding_text: a small selected color interval remains attached to one continuous surface with shared shading and texture while surrounding chroma is restrained without pasted-mask edges

color_grading.ko: 저채도에서도 인접 재질과 영역의 색 분리가 남는 관계
color_grading.en: low-chroma rendering that preserves subtle color separation between adjacent materials and regions
color_grading.embedding_text: overall chroma stays restrained while adjacent skin fabric object and background regions retain small but readable hue differences instead of collapsing into one gray or tinted wash

weather.ko: 날씨가 재질과 피사체 상태에 남긴 결과 사슬
weather.en: weather-to-material-to-subject consequence chain with visible local traces
weather.embedding_text: one readable weather condition produces a local trace on a named material surface and one compatible visible subject response, such as wet edges, displaced hair, condensation, or pressed clothing

relational_action.ko: 두 성인이 하나의 보이는 물체를 주고받는 미완 인계
relational_action.en: two clearly adult actors handing off one visible shared object during an unfinished transfer
relational_action.embedding_text: two separately legible adult actors share exactly one visible object as the giver releases it and the receiver aligns a hand and visible response toward that same target

relational_action.ko: 프레임 밖 동반자의 연결된 사지와 접촉이 남는 관계
relational_action.en: cropped companion relation with an owned entering limb, visible contact, and compatible response
relational_action.embedding_text: a partially off-frame companion retains one limb visibly connected to an owner, a precise contact or offer point, and a compatible orientation or response from the primary subject

partner_framing.ko: 전경·배경 두 인물의 깊이와 가림 순서가 분리되는 관계
partner_framing.en: two-actor foreground-background relation with coherent depth order, occlusion edge, and interaction vector
partner_framing.embedding_text: two distinct actors occupy foreground and background with a coherent overlap edge, preserved face or body landmarks, and one requested gaze or action relation rather than a merged silhouette

partner_framing.ko: 프레임 가장자리에서 들어오는 동반자 사지의 소유 관계
partner_framing.en: frame-edge companion limb with a readable owner direction and uninterrupted anatomical connection
partner_framing.embedding_text: a companion's partial arm or leg enters from a named frame edge with continuous anatomy, clear owner direction, and a visible relation action instead of a floating body part

proxemics.ko: 작은 집단이 하나의 표적 주위에 접근 공간을 공유하는 대형
proxemics.en: focused small group forming shared access around one visible target
proxemics.embedding_text: a bounded number of primary participants orient toward one visible focal target with clear access gaps and distinct roles while any background crowd remains contextual

gaze_target.ko: 머리 방향과 눈동자 방향이 서로 다른 표적 관계
gaze_target.en: head and eye counter-orientation toward two readable directions without breaking anatomy
gaze_target.embedding_text: the head turns toward one readable direction while the irises return toward a second visible target, preserving believable eye aperture, sclera balance, neck connection, and target geometry

expression.ko: 가림과 조명 속에서도 얼굴 국소 동작이 원본 크기에서 읽히는 상태
expression.en: native-scale facial display readability with head, eyes, and local actions separately observable
expression.embedding_text: the crop light and occlusion preserve enough native detail to judge head direction, iris direction, brow or lid action, and mouth action separately without inferring an emotion label

surface_material.ko: 주름 방향을 따라 넓은 광택이 이동하는 새틴 계열 드레이프
surface_material.en: continuous satin-like drape whose broad smooth luster follows fold direction and curvature
surface_material.embedding_text: one continuous satin-like garment surface keeps seams and edges while a broad smooth highlight follows coherent fold curvature and darker planes retain material detail

surface_material.ko: 방향과 압박에 따라 밝기가 달라지는 벨벳 파일·냅 표면
surface_material.en: velvet-like short pile whose brightness changes with nap direction, fold, and local compression
surface_material.embedding_text: a continuous velvet-like garment shows short pile or nap cues, direction-dependent bright and dark regions, local fold or pressure response, and traceable seams and edges

hair_style.ko: 한 바람 방향이 뿌리·중간·끝 가닥을 일관되게 이동시키는 헤어 상태
hair_style.en: wind-displaced hair with coherent force direction from roots through mid-lengths to free ends
hair_style.embedding_text: one readable wind direction displaces hair from root lift through mid-length curvature to leading and trailing ends while the hairstyle topology and face remain identifiable

skin_finish.ko: 국소 광원 반응과 함께 모공·미세결이 남는 피부 표면
skin_finish.en: skin microtexture retained through local diffuse and specular light response
skin_finish.embedding_text: native detail retains pores, fine relief, local color variation, small direction-owned speculars, and highlight rolloff on one visible skin region without claiming health or identity

capture_context.ko: 전면 카메라 저조도에서 나타날 수 있는 근거리·신호 응답 후보
capture_context.en: front-camera low-light response treated as advisory near-field geometry and signal behavior
capture_context.embedding_text: an arm-length front-camera view may combine near-field perspective, weak display illumination, low-light signal smoothing, and compression traces, but the device brand and RAW status are not asserted

capture_context.ko: 장비·포맷 라벨과 실제 픽셀 효과를 분리하는 촬영 응답
capture_context.en: capture label preserved as metadata while only visible geometry, signal, and processing effects become image candidates
capture_context.embedding_text: camera lens sensor film RAW or brand words remain input labels while perspective focus noise rolloff halation compression and color response require their own observable evidence

narrative_phase.ko: 접촉 직전의 준비 동작과 보이는 간격
narrative_phase.en: pre-contact readiness with an explicit visible gap between actor and target
narrative_phase.embedding_text: the actor and target remain separated by a visible gap while body and hand vectors show imminent contact rather than completed action or static posing

narrative_phase.ko: 이동 중 몸통과 진행 방향이 어긋나는 중간 단계
narrative_phase.en: mid-locomotion counterturn with travel direction and torso rotation simultaneously readable
narrative_phase.embedding_text: an unfinished stride preserves a readable travel vector, changing support, and torso counterturn without collapsing into a static twist or blur-only motion

narrative_phase.ko: 액체가 출발 용기에서 수신 용기로 이동하는 중간 단계
narrative_phase.en: mid-transfer liquid path visibly connecting one source vessel to one receiver
narrative_phase.embedding_text: one visible continuous liquid stream leaves a source vessel and enters a distinct receiver while the source tilt and receiving level show the transfer is still underway

narrative_phase.ko: 도구가 표적에 닿아 공정이 진행되는 단계
narrative_phase.en: active process phase with coherent tool-target contact and an immediate trace
narrative_phase.embedding_text: the tool stays coherently connected to its target during an unfinished process while force direction and one immediate trace or state change remain visible

narrative_phase.ko: 접촉 해제 뒤에도 이어지는 궤적 단계
narrative_phase.en: post-contact release with a continuing actor or object trajectory
narrative_phase.embedding_text: a new separation gap appears after contact while the actor or object continues along a readable trajectory and the contact site retains one residual consequence

narrative_phase.ko: 실수의 결과와 수습 동작이 함께 보이는 단계
narrative_phase.en: visible mishap repair phase with a localized consequence and active corrective action
narrative_phase.embedding_text: one localized mishap consequence remains visible while the actor performs a concrete corrective action on that same target and the recovery is still incomplete

narrative_phase.ko: 아직 손대지 않은 표적과 사용 직전 문턱
narrative_phase.en: pre-use threshold with an untouched target, prepared actor, and explicit remaining gap
narrative_phase.embedding_text: the target remains visibly untouched while a prepared hand or tool approaches across a clear gap and no use-result trace has appeared yet

narrative_phase.ko: 주동작 뒤 결과가 가라앉는 잔여 단계
narrative_phase.en: settling aftereffect phase with a visible residual trace and diminishing motion
narrative_phase.embedding_text: a visible residual trace such as droplets dust displaced fabric or ripples is still settling while motion diminishes and the initiating action need not be inferred off-frame
